scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks up a rocky path toward a hillside of olive trees, with a distant town and hills in warm sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:1, which says Jesus went to the Mount of Olives. The path, landscape, clothing, sunlight, and distant town are artistic details. The excerpt's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In warm morning light, Jesus sits on stone steps in a temple courtyard and gestures as people gather to listen, while others approach.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:2: early in the morning he comes again to the temple, the people come to him, and he sits and teaches them. The courtyard, clothing, and arrangement of the people are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman in a blue robe stands among robed men who bring her before a seated man, while others watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 8:3, in which the scribes and Pharisees bring to him a woman caught in adultery and set her in the midst. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined. The supplied English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of robed men speak and gesture toward a woman as a seated teacher listens.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:4, in which the speakers tell the Teacher that the woman was caught in the act of adultery. The setting, figures, and gestures are imagined from the Nestle 1904 text and Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed man holding a rolled scroll gestures toward a seated teacher while other men and a worried woman stand nearby; stones lie on the ground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the question in John 8:5, where the speakers invoke Moses' command concerning stoning and ask what the person addressed says. The people, poses, courtyard, scroll, and stones are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus crouches and traces marks in dusty ground with his finger while four men stand nearby, watching and gesturing beneath a tree beside stone buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:6: while others speak to test Jesus and seek grounds to accuse him, he bends down and writes on the ground with his finger. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus addresses a group of men while a woman stands nearby and one man holds a stone at his side.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:7: after being persistently questioned, Jesus answers that the one without sin should cast the first stone at her. The setting, clothing, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stoops and traces marks in the dusty ground with his finger, with a sunlit stone courtyard and trees behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 8:8, where he stoops down again and continues writing on the ground. His appearance, the use of a finger, the marks, and the setting are imagined; the verse does not say what he wrote.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and a woman stand together in a sunlit stone courtyard as several people walk away toward a gate, with an older man farthest along.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:9: after hearing, the people depart one by one, beginning with the older ones, leaving Jesus and the woman standing in the midst. The setting, clothing and expressions are imagined. The scene follows the supplied Greek excerpt and its Berean Interlinear token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands facing a woman in a sunlit stone courtyard, extending one hand as she looks toward him. No one else is visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:10: Jesus looks up, sees only the woman, and asks where her accusers are and whether anyone has condemned her. The courtyard, clothing, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits and extends an open hand toward a woman seated on the ground; they look at one another, with an open archway and path behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:11: the woman answers, “No one, Sir,” and Jesus tells her that he does not condemn her and to go and sin no more. The courtyard, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices. The English word glosses in the source excerpt are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus turns to speak to a group of followers on a stone path, with shaded rocks behind them and warm golden light, greenery, and a distant village ahead.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Jesus speaking and people following him from shadow into light, reflecting his words that he is the light of the world and that the one who follows him will have the light of life. The path and landscape are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands calmly in a sunlit stone courtyard while one of four Pharisees speaks with an open-handed gesture and the others look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the Pharisees telling Jesus that he bears witness about himself and that his testimony is not true. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are imagined; the accusation is theirs.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a leafy tree with one hand to his chest, speaking to several listeners; a winding road leads toward distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation and road evoke John 8:14, where Jesus says his testimony about himself is true because he knows where he came from and where he is going, while his listeners do not. The setting and road are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits with open hands beside a man in a patched cloak while two men watch from the side.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the verse's contrast between judging according to the flesh and Jesus judging no one; the setting, people, and gestures are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in a cream robe and rust-red cloak speaks with an outstretched hand to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a beam of light to suggest the presence of the one who sent Jesus. John 8:16 says that his judgment is true because he is not alone; the courtyard, listeners, and light are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men gesture as they speak to a seated elder across a low table with a blank scroll, in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hearing evokes the verse's statement that the testimony of two men is true as written in the law. The people and setting are artistic additions, not a reconstruction of a recorded event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other extended as attentive listeners gather around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus bearing witness about himself and the Father who sent him also bearing witness about him. The warm light is a visual symbol of the Father's witness, not a claim that light visibly appeared. The scene follows the supplied Greek verse and its Berean Interlinear token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus speaks with one hand on his chest and the other extended while four listeners watch, one gesturing toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 8:19: people ask where Jesus' Father is, and Jesus replies that they know neither him nor his Father; if they had known him, they would also have known his Father. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among listeners and teaches beside offering chests in a sunlit temple court with stone columns.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus teaching in the temple treasury while no one seizes him; John 8:20 says that his hour had not yet come.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing toward a road winding into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene reflects Jesus speaking of going away, his hearers seeking him, their dying in sin, and their inability to come where he goes. The courtyard, the road and the gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of men in ancient clothing exchange questioning looks and gestures while a robed teacher stands apart.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined portrayal of the Jewish listeners in John 8:22 wondering whether the speaker would kill himself because he said they could not come where he was going. The conversation, courtyard and gestures are artistic imagination; the image does not depict an act or establish his intention.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a bright sky while six listeners gather around him on a rocky path, with a tree, water, and distant buildings in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene uses Jesus' gesture toward the sky and the listeners' place on the earth to evoke his contrast in John 8:23: they are from below and of this world, while he is from above and not of this world. The contrast follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses; the setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on stone steps in a sunlit courtyard, touching his chest and extending an open hand as a group of men and women listen thoughtfully.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus speaking the warning in John 8:24: those who do not believe that he is [He] will die in their sins. The courtyard and the listeners' poses are artistic choices. The wording follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking with an open hand in a sunlit stone courtyard as a man gestures toward him and other men listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 8:25: people ask Jesus who he is, and he replies to them. The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretations based on the supplied Greek text and Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard and gestures as he speaks to a group of attentive listeners; a town and hills are visible through an archway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus addressing listeners evokes John 8:26, in which he speaks of having much to say and judge concerning them and of speaking to the world what he heard from the true One who sent him. The courtyard and listeners are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed speaker raises an open hand while addressing listeners seated in a sunny stone courtyard; several look puzzled or thoughtful.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a speaker addressing listeners who did not understand that he was speaking to them about the Father. The setting and gestures are artistic inventions, based on the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses for John 8:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in a cream robe and rust-red mantle speaks with open hands to attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard. A cross-shaped shadow falls across the paving.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus speaking to his listeners in John 8:28. The cross-shaped shadow suggests the future lifting up he describes; it is an artistic interpretation, not a detail stated in the verse. The attentive listeners evoke his words that they will come to know, and his gesture suggests his speaking what the Father taught him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor illustration of Jesus seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a group of listeners.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of Jesus teaching in warm light evokes his words that the One who sent him is with him and has not left him alone, and that he always does what pleases him. The verse does not specify this courtyard or these listeners.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaks with open hands to a gathered crowd of attentive men, women, and children.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 8:30: as Jesus speaks, many believe in him. The courtyard, appearances, and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses used for the scene come from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while teaching an attentive group seated together in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath leafy vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined teaching scene illustrates Jesus speaking to Jews who had believed in him about abiding in his word and truly being his disciples. The courtyard, appearances, and arrangement are imagined. The verse relationship follows the supplied Berean Interlinear token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people in ancient clothing walk toward an open stone gateway in golden light, smiling as broken chains fall around them. Hills and a village lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses illuminating light to suggest the truth being known, and broken chains and an open gateway to suggest the freedom the truth brings. The verse does not describe a literal imprisonment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus listens as four men gather beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard; one man holds out both hands as he speaks.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the reply in John 8:33: the speakers call themselves Abraham's offspring, say they have never been in bondage to anyone, and ask how they will become free. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard. A thoughtful man in the foreground wears wrist shackles, with his chain tangled among thorny vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' words in John 8:34: the chain and thorns symbolize the bondage to sin described in the verse, rather than an event stated in the text.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carrying a bundle walks away from a stone house and looks back toward a younger man standing in its sunlit doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene illustrates John 8:35's contrast between the slave, who does not abide in the house for the age, and the son, who abides for the age. The depicted departure is an artistic imagining.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus loosens a chain at a man's wrist as they and a small group walk through an open stone gateway into sunlit countryside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the loosening chain and open gateway as a visual metaphor for the Son setting people free, as described in John 8:36. The verse does not describe a literal gate or chain.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing toward a group of stern listeners; one man holds a stone at his side.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus addressing Abraham's descendants as they resist his word and seek to kill him. The courtyard, olive tree, and stone are artistic details not specified in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard and speaks with an open hand to a group of listeners; two men confer quietly and another turns away, with trees and distant buildings behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggests the contrast in John 8:38 between what Jesus has seen with the Father and speaks, and what his listeners have heard from the father and do. The courtyard, gestures, and figures' actions are illustrative, not a claim about the historical setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, extending a hand toward a group of listeners. One man stands with both hands against his chest while the others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:39, based on the supplied Greek verse and Berean Interlinear glosses: people say Abraham is their father, and Jesus says that if they were Abraham's children they would do Abraham's works. The setting, gestures, and olive tree are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures with open hands as he speaks to stern listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined exchange illustrates John 8:40: Jesus says they seek to kill him although he has spoken truth he heard from God, and that Abraham did not do this. The setting and appearances are imaginative.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man addresses a group in a sunlit stone courtyard. One listener holds a hand to his chest and raises the other toward the sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imagined scene of the exchange in John 8:41: the speaker says that they are doing the works of their father, and they respond that they were not born of sexual immorality and have one Father, God. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, gesturing upward as a group of listeners gathers around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene relates to Jesus telling his listeners that if God were their Father they would love him, and that he came from God and was sent by him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated teacher in a sunlit stone courtyard gestures with open hands toward five listeners, who look thoughtful or puzzled.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the speaker asking why his speech is not understood and saying that his listeners are unable to hear his word. The courtyard, gestures, and expressions are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A teacher speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard while a dark, reaching figure rises behind a cracked mask, a smoking oil lamp, and a broken blade.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the verse’s warning: the shadow and objects suggest the devil’s murderous nature, falsehood, and absence of truth. The scene is not a historical reconstruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of Jesus seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a group of listeners. One man turns away with folded arms while others look doubtful.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter reflects John 8:45: Jesus says that because he speaks the truth, his listeners do not believe him. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a sunlit stone courtyard with his hands open, addressing a group of men whose expressions are thoughtful and questioning.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus asking who can convict him concerning sin and why his hearers do not believe him if he speaks the truth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated teacher gestures as one listener looks up attentively while others look away or appear preoccupied.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes the contrast in John 8:47 between hearing God's words and not hearing them, which the verse relates to being of God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands calmly in a sunlit stone courtyard while a man gestures toward him and several other men look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative portrayal of John 8:48, in which the speakers question Jesus and accuse him of being a Samaritan and having a demon. Their accusation is represented through gesture, not presented as fact.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus gestures upward while answering several men who watch with doubtful expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of John 8:49: Jesus denies having a demon, says he honors his Father, and tells his listeners they dishonor him. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand near his heart and the other raised toward the light, while a group of listeners watches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined scene reflects Jesus' words that he does not seek his own glory and that there is One who seeks it and judges. The courtyard, listeners and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while speaking to a seated listener who holds a hand over his heart beneath an olive tree; a sunlit path winds through the hills toward the horizon.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Jesus speaking to a listener who holds his words close. The living olive tree and path toward the light evoke his promise that whoever keeps his word will never see death. The setting, gestures and landscape are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus listens as four men in ancient robes address him with questioning gestures; an olive branch and a hilly landscape appear behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the exchange in John 8:52. The speakers accuse Jesus and refer to the deaths of Abraham and the prophets while repeating his words about keeping his word and never tasting death. The courtyard, landscape and olive branch are artistic additions; the accusation is theirs.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits facing three men in a sunlit landscape. One man extends a hand as if asking a question, while two others listen; unmarked rock-cut tomb openings appear on the distant hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation evokes John 8:53, where Jesus is asked whether he is greater than Abraham, who died, and the prophets, who also died, and whom he makes himself. The distant tombs are a visual reminder of death, not identified burial sites or a claim about the actual setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to a small group of attentive listeners as golden light falls from above.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus answering that self-glorification is nothing and that his Father glorifies him, the one his listeners call their God. The courtyard and light are artistic interpretations, not details stated in the verse. English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other raised, with a closed scroll on his lap.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' words about knowing God, speaking truthfully, and keeping God's word. The courtyard, gestures, and scroll are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly Abraham stands with his arms open on a rocky hillside, smiling toward a golden sunrise over distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative sunrise evokes the day Jesus says Abraham rejoiced to see; the verse does not describe a sunrise or specify how Abraham saw it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four men in a sunlit stone courtyard question Jesus, who listens calmly as one of them gestures with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the question in John 8:57: how could Jesus, who was not yet fifty, have seen Abraham? The setting, appearances, and gestures are artistic additions. The word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone step and gestures as five listeners gather around him beneath a star-filled sky, with a distant town and hills beyond them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Jesus speaking to listeners as he says that before Abraham was, he is. The starry sky is a visual suggestion of the span of time, not a detail stated in the verse. The wording follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus slips behind a stone column toward the temple gateway while people in the courtyard raise stones.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 8:59: people take up stones to throw at Jesus, who hides and leaves the temple. The column, gateway, and gestures are artistic details.
